summary: Expanded R8 into a 15-case abuse catalog with qualitative severity/likelihood, preventive invariants, detection signals, and recovery controls.
Added proposed typed AuthorizationGrant, VerificationEvidence, and AbuseSecurityEvent semantics without promoting exact schema names into accepted state.

Added RT11-RT25 synthetic red-team cases covering prompt injection, target mutation, approval-dialog manipulation, replay, ambiguous retry, provider identity conflict, credential social engineering, service substitution, research poisoning, malicious peer messages, stale approval, and workflow amplification.
Current Canadian CLHIA evidence through August 24, 2026 confirms active provider false-claim investigations and provider-identity misuse as real abuse classes.

Current OWASP and NIST agent-security guidance supports complete mediation, least privilege, human approval for high-impact actions, and treating external content as untrusted data rather than authorization.

Carry the ten proposed R8 pilot gates into P0 architecture reconciliation if supported.

Require synthetic RT11-RT25 before any real-member/live-adapter pilot.
